steps.clue: Install T.E.D.D.’s head to activate Ol’ Tessie.
Reactivate Klaus and use him to recover the Aether Barrel.
Charge the Aether Barrel, solve the cube and obtain the Necrofluid Gauntlet.
Prepare the serum and complete the lockdown in Yuri’s Lab.
Use the three keys to open the Seal of Sorrow and install the DG-2 Turret.
Use the clock tower to charge the Necrofluid Gauntlet and complete the four location challenges.
Collect the twelve wisps with Ol’ Tessie along the required route.
Use Ol’ Tessie to defeat Veytharion.
